schema.name: fleet_status
schema.description:
Watcher cadence and confirmed outcomes — flota, último éxito, bloqueo humano.
Published metadata only: no configuration, URLs, notes, queries or log bodies.
Sinónimos: flota, vigilante parado, último éxito, bloqueo humano, cadencia de vigilancia.

schema.name: tantalus_overview
schema.description:
What is new since the last visit: alerts, buyable now, blocked, top finds. Novedades del vigilante.
The dashboard in one call: unseen confirmed events (restock, price drop, pre-order, new SKU, second-hand find, news), targets buyable now, targets that need a human (CAPTCHA/login), per-watcher status, top second-hand listings, material news, proposed URLs.
Sinónimos: novedades, qué hay nuevo, restock, reposición, ofertas, alertas, resumen, estado de los vigilantes.

schema.name: tantalus_status
schema.description:
Health: scheduler, notification channels, model, search engines, browser, counts. Estado de Tantalus.
Sinónimos: salud, canales de aviso, navegador, motores de búsqueda.

schema.name: watcher_list
schema.description:
List watchers (availability, second-hand, information) with their counts. Lista de vigilantes.
Sinónimos: vigilantes, alertas configuradas, qué estoy vigilando.

schema.name: watcher_get
schema.description: One watcher with its config, targets, sources, candidates and recent events. Detalle de un vigilante.

schema.name: watcher_create
schema.description:
Create a watcher: availability (stock, price), secondhand or information (news). Crear vigilante.
Secondhand covers Wallapop and Facebook Marketplace. For availability, pass targets (product or retailer-search URLs) and discovery queries. Sinónimos: vigila, avísame cuando haya stock, alerta de precio, busca de segunda mano, seguimiento de noticias.

config.description: availability: {product:{terms:[...], must:[...], exclude:[...]}, region, stores:[...], policies:{seller: retail_only|retail_plus_marketplace|any_below, alert_on:[RESTOCK,...], require_confidence:75, revalidate_seconds:60, cooldown_minutes:20, min_drop_pct:5, price_threshold, msrp, scalper_multiplier}, discovery:{queries:[...], retailers:[...], terms:[...]}, channels:[...]}. secondhand: {pack: books_bulk|generic|collectibles_sealed, sources:[wallapop, facebook], queries:[...], settings:{origin_location, radius_km, price_ceiling, msrp, include_any, include_all, exclude}}. information: {sources:[{kind: page|feed|search, value, label}], info:{must_terms, boost_terms, exclude_terms, official_domains, freshness_days}}.
config.title: Config

interval_min.description: Check cadence. Hot restock 5-15, normal retail 15-30, stable 60, news 60-240.
interval_min.title: Interval Min

targets.description: availability: product or retailer-search URLs to add right away.
targets.title: Targets

budget_category.description: Ledger budget category: alerts with a price add 'quedan X € en <categoría>'.
budget_category.title: Budget Category

schema.name: watcher_update
schema.description: Change a watcher's name, config, cadence, discovery cadence or enabled flag. Editar vigilante.

config.description: Replaces the whole config; read watcher_get first.
config.title: Config

config_patch.description: Atomically merges changed config fields; nested objects merge, arrays replace, null removes a key. Other fields are preserved.
config_patch.title: Config Patch

budget_category.description: Ledger budget category for the alert text; empty clears it.
budget_category.title: Budget Category

schema.name: watcher_delete
schema.description: Delete a watcher and all its history (confirm=true). Borrar vigilante.

schema.name: watcher_run
schema.description: Run a watcher now: check every target / sweep second-hand / check news sources. Comprobar ahora.

schema.name: watcher_rescore
schema.description: Score a second-hand watcher's stored listings again with its current pack (no alerts). Repuntuar anuncios.

schema.name: target_add
schema.description:
Add a product or retailer-search URL to an availability watcher and check it. Añadir URL a vigilar.
Supports product pages (JSON-LD / buttons), retailer search pages (new SKUs appear as NEW_SKU) and nvidia-api:search?term=... Sinónimos: vigila esta URL, añade esta tienda, seguimiento de precio de este producto.

url.description: Product page, retailer search page, or nvidia-api:search?term=...
url.title: Url

msrp.description: Reference retail price; the ceiling becomes msrp x scalper_multiplier.
msrp.title: Msrp

price_threshold.description: Alert when the price falls to or below this.
price_threshold.title: Price Threshold

check_now.description: Run a first check right away.
check_now.title: Check Now

schema.name: target_list
schema.description: List targets with their last state, price and confidence. Lista de productos vigilados.

schema.name: target_get
schema.description: One target with observations (evidence, confidence), price history and events. Historial de producto.

schema.name: target_update
schema.description:
Change a target: label, URL, SKU, MSRP, price limits, seller policy, fetch tier, pause. Editar objetivo.
SKU/EAN, price ceiling and price threshold are separate fields.

clear.description: Fields to reset to empty (null means 'unchanged' elsewhere).
clear.title: Clear

schema.name: target_delete
schema.description: Delete a target and its history (confirm=true). Borrar objetivo.

schema.name: target_check
schema.description: Check one target now (fetch ladder, extraction, events). Comprobar este producto ahora.

schema.name: target_resolve
schema.description:
Open a visible browser so the user passes a CAPTCHA or login, then re-check. Resolver bloqueo.
Only when the user is at the computer and asks. Never solves anything itself.

schema.name: inspect_url
schema.description:
One-off stock, price and seller of a product or search page, without saving. ¿Hay stock? ¿Precio?
Sinónimos: mira esta página, comprueba precio, está disponible, agotado.

show_text.description: Include up to 3000 chars of the readable page text.
show_text.title: Show Text

schema.name: events_list
schema.description: Events (RESTOCK, PRICE_DROP, PREORDER_OPEN, NEW_SKU, NEW_LISTING...) with filters. Historial de avisos.

types.description: RESTOCK, LOCAL_RESTOCK, PREORDER_OPEN, PRICE_DROP, PRICE_THRESHOLD_CROSSED, NEW_SKU, RESTOCK_DATE_CONFIRMED, SOLD_OUT, NEW_LISTING, LISTING_PRICE_DROP, INFO_CHANGE, CANDIDATE_FOUND, NEEDS_HUMAN, MAIL_DEAL, RELEASE, SALE_OPEN
types.title: Types

schema.name: events_mark_seen
schema.description: Mark events seen (all, or some ids) and record a dashboard visit. Marcar como visto.

event_ids.description: Omit to mark everything seen (records a dashboard visit).
event_ids.title: Event Ids

schema.name: event_dismiss
schema.description: Dismiss an event (false positive, not interested). Descartar aviso.

schema.name: event_notify
schema.description: Send an event again through the notification channels that did not get it. Reenviar aviso.

schema.name: listings_list
schema.description: Second-hand listings found by the watchers, with score, signals and distance. Anuncios de segunda mano.

schema.name: listing_set
schema.description: Mark a second-hand listing seen / saved / dismissed / gone. Guardar o descartar anuncio.

schema.name: info_items_list
schema.description: News found by information watchers with verdict (confirmed / leak / estimate). Novedades informativas.

schema.name: info_item_set
schema.description: Mark a news item seen or dismissed. Marcar noticia vista o descartada.

schema.name: candidates_list
schema.description: URLs proposed by discovery for availability watchers. Páginas propuestas.

schema.name: candidate_accept
schema.description: Turn a proposed URL into a watched target. Aceptar propuesta.

schema.name: candidate_reject
schema.description: Reject a proposed URL. Rechazar propuesta.

schema.name: discovery_run
schema.description: Search the web for new product / retailer URLs for an availability watcher. Descubrir nuevas URLs.

schema.name: web_search
schema.description: Web or news search (DuckDuckGo, Bing, Google News, Bing News, SearXNG, Brave). Buscar en web o noticias.

news.description: Search news (Google News and Bing News RSS) instead of the web.
news.title: News

schema.name: secondhand_search
schema.description:
One-off Wallapop or Facebook search scored by a pack, near a town, without saving. Buscar de segunda mano.
Packs: books_bulk (free books in bulk), generic, collectibles_sealed (sealed TCG, anti-scalper). Sinónimos: wallapop, segunda mano, lotes, gratis, cerca de mí.

schema.name: secondhand_facebook_login
schema.description: Open a visible browser to log in to Facebook once (for Marketplace). Iniciar sesión en Facebook.

schema.name: packs_list
schema.description: Second-hand scoring packs with their fields. Perfiles de puntuación.

schema.name: presets_list
schema.description: Ready-made watchers and whether they are installed. Plantillas.

schema.name: presets_install
schema.description: Install ready-made watchers. Instalar plantillas.

ids.description: Omit to install every preset that is not installed yet.
ids.title: Ids

schema.name: notify_status
schema.description: Notification channels (toast, hub, ntfy, telegram, email): setup, switches, recent sends. Canales de aviso.

schema.name: notify_test
schema.description: Send a test notification through one channel. Probar canal.

via.description: hub = a sample notification through the family hub's notification centre (it decides the channels); own = test the channel itself.
via.title: Via

schema.name: telegram_find_chat_id
schema.description: After the user writes to the bot, find the chat id with getUpdates. Obtener chat id de Telegram.

schema.name: settings_set
schema.description:
Change settings: channels, ntfy server, e-mail backend and Faustus folder, language, model, pause. Ajustes.
Keys: notify.via auto|hub|own, mail.source auto|hub|faustus, notify.<channel>.enabled|min_severity, notify.ntfy.server, notify.email.backend|faustus_dir|faustus_owner, notify.language, llm.enabled, scheduler.paused, mail.deals.enabled|interval_min|history_days|ttl_days|stores|domains|gamerhoard_file|wishlist, mail.noise.days.

values.description: notify.<channel>.enabled 1|0, notify.<channel>.min_severity low|medium|high, notify.ntfy.server, notify.language es|en, llm.enabled 1|0, scheduler.paused 0|1
values.title: Values

schema.name: secret_set
schema.description: Save a write-only secret (Telegram, ntfy, SMTP, Brave key, SearXNG URL). Guardar credencial.

name.description: TELEGRAM_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, NTFY_TOPIC, NTFY_TOKEN, SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD, SMTP_FROM, SMTP_TO, BRAVE_KEY, SEARXNG_URL
name.title: Name

value.description: Empty removes it. Write-only: the value is never returned.
value.title: Value

schema.name: scheduler_status
schema.description: Scheduler queue and per-host fetch state (blocks, cooldowns, preferred tier). Estado del planificador.

schema.name: runs_list
schema.description: Recent runs (checks, sweeps, discovery) with their summaries. Ejecuciones recientes.

schema.name: config_export
schema.description: Export every watcher and target as data (declarative config). Exportar configuración.

schema.name: config_import
schema.description: Import watchers and targets from config_export data (updates by name). Importar configuración.

schema.name: mail_deals
schema.description:
Sale mails of game and book stores found in the mailbox, with wishlist matches. Ofertas del correo.
Read from the Faustus mailbox (read-only), parsed into deals: store, title, discount, price, end date, link, and whether it matches a wishlist (game library, own list, the store's wishlist mails) or a watcher. Only matches notify. Sinónimos: ofertas de Steam, GOG, libros, rebajas del correo, lista de deseados.

matched_only.description: Only deals that match a wishlist or a watcher.
matched_only.title: Matched Only

store.description: Store id: steam, gog, game, epic, bibliostock, casadellibro, fnac...
store.title: Store

query.description: Text in the title, the item titles or the subject.
query.title: Query

schema.name: mail_deals_scan
schema.description:
Read new sale mails now (read-only) and match them to wishlists. Escanear ofertas del correo.
The first scan is quiet (no alerts); later matches notify once. rematch_only re-checks stored deals; rebuild re-reads everything. Sinónimos: buscar ofertas en el correo, actualizar ofertas, revisar correo de tiendas.

days.description: How far back to read (default: setting mail.deals.history_days).
days.title: Days

rematch_only.description: Do not read the mailbox: only check the stored deals against the lists again.
rematch_only.title: Rematch Only

rebuild.description: Forget the stored deals and read the mailbox again with the current parser (quiet, no alerts).
rebuild.title: Rebuild

schema.name: mail_noise_report
schema.description:
Which sender domains flood the mailbox with promotions, and who reads them. Informe de ruido del correo.
Read-only: counts per domain, share, Gmail category, unsubscribe link or address (never opened), last mail, and whether a Hoard uses that sender. Nothing is unsubscribed, moved or deleted. Sinónimos: spam, newsletters, darse de baja, promociones, limpieza del correo.

refresh.description: Ignore the ten-minute cache and read the headers again.
refresh.title: Refresh

schema.name: mail_deal_set
schema.description: Dismiss a mail deal or bring it back. Descartar o restaurar una oferta del correo.

schema.name: radar_status
schema.description:
Aggregator radar: shops with stock now per chain (Carrefour, GAME, El Corte Inglés...). Radar de tiendas.
Per chain, the matching products it has in stock or on pre-order and the ones that sold out recently, read from stock aggregators (stocktcg.net / stocktcg.es) because Carrefour and others block direct reading. Sinónimos: stock en Carrefour, qué hay en GAME, tiendas.

schema.name: radar_run
schema.description:
Read the stock aggregators now: feeds, chain pages, release pages, product pages. Comprobar radar ahora.
Raises RESTOCK / PREORDER_OPEN per shop and RELEASE for matching releases. Sinónimos: actualizar stock, mirar tiendas ahora.

watcher_id.description: Only this watcher; empty = every watcher with the radar on.
watcher_id.title: Watcher Id

schema.name: releases_list
schema.description:
Upcoming releases for the watchers: date, where to buy, where sold out. Calendario de lanzamientos.
Date, products, chains (in stock / pre-order / sold out with price) and the cheapest shops with stock or pre-order. Sinónimos: qué sale hoy, próximos lanzamientos, oleada, preventas, dónde comprar.

schema.name: radar_offers
schema.description:
Shop offers seen on the stock aggregators, filterable by shop, state and product. Ofertas por tienda.
Sinónimos: quién tiene stock, precio por tienda, dónde hay, agotado en.

store.description: Shop slug or name: carrefour, game, el-corte-ingles, amazon, alcampo, toys-r-us...
store.title: Store

buyable.description: true = in stock or pre-order now; false = sold out.
buyable.title: Buyable

schema.name: watchers_match_purchase
schema.description:
Which watchers were waiting for this purchase? Score 0..1 by title, shop and EAN/ASIN. ¿Ya lo he comprado?
Fuzzy match of a purchase (title, merchant, URL) against active watchers: shared product words, same EAN, ASIN or product page. Read-only. Sinónimos: compré esto, vigilante de este producto, coincide con una compra.

title.description: What was bought (the order's item title).
title.title: Title

url.description: Product URL of the purchase when known (EAN, ASIN or product id are matched).
url.title: Url

schema.name: watcher_mark_bought
schema.description:
Mark a watcher as bought: stops its checks, keeps the history. Ya lo he comprado, dejar de vigilar.
Status bought, emits tantalus.watcher.bought {watcher_id, purchase_ref}. watcher_update enabled=true watches it again. Sinónimos: comprado, dejar de vigilar, archivar vigilante.

purchase_ref.description: hoard:// reference of the purchase, kept on the watcher.
purchase_ref.title: Purchase Ref

schema.name: watcher_add
schema.description:
Watch a product for a price or a restock from just a name (and URL). Vigilar algo, idea de regalo.
Creates an availability watcher with the name's words, an optional product page and price limit (budget), idempotent by source_ref. Sinónimos: vigila esto, avísame cuando baje de precio, regalo, lista de deseos.

name.description: What to watch for (product name). title or text work as aliases.
name.title: Name

url.description: Optional product page to watch right away.
url.title: Url

budget.description: Alert when the price falls to or below this. max_price is an alias.
budget.title: Budget

source_ref.description: hoard:// reference of where the idea came from (a gift idea); same ref = same watcher.
source_ref.title: Source Ref

schema.name: radar_setup
schema.description:
Turn the aggregator radar on or off for a watcher and choose chains, languages, sources. Configurar radar.
Sinónimos: activar radar, avisar de Carrefour, cadenas, idiomas de edición.

chains.description: Shop slugs that always alert (game, carrefour, el-corte-ingles, alcampo, amazon, toys-r-us, toy-planet...).
chains.title: Chains

languages.description: Edition languages that may alert, e.g. [ES, EN]. Empty = any.
languages.title: Languages

alert_other_shops.description: Small shops alert too, only at a sane price (cheapest chain price or MSRP × multiplier).
alert_other_shops.title: Alert Other Shops
